2.251.5
MapPolygonLayer.MapCenterPointRules
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapPolygonLayer.MapCenterPointRules element specifies a set of rules to be applied to a
MapPolygon center point in the parent layer. This element is optional. This element is of type
MapPointRules.
Following is the parent element of the MapPolygonLayer.MapCenterPointRules element.
Parent elements
MapPolygonLayer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapPolygonLayer.MapCenterPointRules
element.
 <xsd:element name="MapCenterPointRules" type="MapPointRulesType" minOccurs="0" />
